messages.subject: Path Analysis with Interactions and Indirect Effects in R
parts:
Hello LAVAAN members

This seminar offers practical skills to enhance your data analytic capabilities using the Lavaan framework. Path Analysis with Interactions and Indirect Effects in R led by Michael Zyphur (University of Queensland and Instats) is now available as an on-demand streaming seminar. This seminar provides a comprehensive introduction to the Lavaan path analytic modeling framework in R, covering basic to advanced regression and path analysis models. Participants will learn to apply indirect effects (mediation), interaction effects (moderation), and conditional indirect effects (moderated mediation) in their research using Lavaan. The practical skills gained, including bootstrapping and interaction effect plotting, will empower researchers to enhance their data analysis capabilities and improve overall research output.

Access this seminar online at your convenience and we'd appreciate you sharing this with colleagues and students!


Best wishes

Michael Zyphur
Professor and Director
